notes.title: Pad Controller Update is here!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

For past months I've been working on pad controller support for Papetura, and.. it's here!

The game supports now various pads, from xbox to pro controller, it should work fine. The gameplay feel quite different, so I encourage you to try it! Also vibrations work, but you can turn them down in game menu if you don't like them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35591478/c5f316ac24f85296ac3a45b938799d1237a9e6a7.png[/img]

Everything should work fine on SteamDeck, I've tested it myself, but if you catch something off - please let me know!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35591478/dde2a172f45830fc292cbf1ce0a52c03b5c71387.jpg[/img]

Also at any point in the game you can switch to mouse control flawlessly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35591478/4f488a5c6743d1b53a5e4c3eeaccb1e204513608.png[/img]

Together with that:

[list]
[*]Major update was to made to the game engine (Unity 2018 -> Unity 2020).
[*]Some graphical assets fixes, and many minor improvements.
[*]Apple Silicon support has been added.
[/list]

That was a lot of work, and I hope you will like new controls. Now Pape can interact with everything within a reach of his hand. Have fun and share your thoughts!

All the best,
Tomasz Ostafin

notes.title: Awards, Upcoming Update and Winter Sale
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

[b]Awards![/b]

Since the release, many of you asked why the game hasn't got any awards. That encouraged me and I applied to many indie competitions! It appears that you were right.. Papetura has won bunch of them, that is pretty overwhelming for me. I attended my first game festival, and finally met many friendly people in-person. 

To wrap things up, here is what happened:

[b]Pixel Awards Europe 2021[/b]
[list]
[*] “Best Art” winner
[*] “Best Audio” winner
[*] “Indie Grand Prix” winner
[/list]
[b]CEEGA Central & Eastern European Game Awards 2021[/b]
[list]
[*] “Visual Art” winner
[*] “Hidden Gem” winner
[/list]
[b]DevGAMM Awards Fall 2021[/b]
[list]
[*] “Excellence In Visual Art” winner
[*] “Excellence In Audio” nomination
[*] “Best Indie Game” nomination
[/list]
[b]Taipei Game Show Indie Game Award 2022[/b] (nominations for now)
[list]
[*] “Best Visual Art”
[*] “Best Innovation”
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35591478/2a07c094cab04795f49103b64bb512be0e3fed14.png[/img]

[b]Upcoming Pad Update![/b]

The work on the game has not ended. While I was developing port on Nintedo Switch testing the game with gamepad was pretty fun, so that option will come also to PC! Some minor changes also will come along the way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35591478/feb26f5d8654f8ae33e0289cbfa3ada7af57bbe0.png[/img]


[b]Winter Sale Discount and Bundle![/b]

Paptura Collector's Edition is out, and it has game, soundtrack and artbook! 
Also Papetura is now -30% off during Winter Sale! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/593640/Papetura/

For upcoming year, I wish all of you all the best!
Happy New Year!

Tomasz

notes.title: Papetura Update Is Here!
notes.content:
[b]Hey Everyone,[/b]

For last months I've been working on Papetura major update, and it's finally here!
The main goal was to move the game to the latest version of the engine, and by doing this, resolve many issues with game not running properly. This was also an opportunity to improve many things in Papetura, from visuals to audio, I went over everything one more time.

[b]Here it is, the changelog:[/b]
- Game engine update - fixed issue with Citrix drivers collision, and possibility to more precisely diagnose crashes.
- Improved/fixed some visuals, animations and sounds.
- Image is more crisp, reduced chromatic aberration a little bit.
- Added characters reactions to projectile hits.
- Increased player walk speed over longer distances.
- Monster chase puzzle is getting easier with more tries.
- Dropped support for all 32bit MacOS (due to engine update)
- Other minor bugs & fixes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35591478/36b275b3391aa71d587017e214bed8cf9ebc9b2d.png[/img]

[b]Have a good time playing or replaying the game!
<3[/b]

[i]PS: If you encounter some game crashes after the update, please try to reinstall the game. Steam updater may unfortunately break some things..[/i]
